name: snomed-rust
summary: SNOMED CT tooling for Rust: RF2 release file parsing, SCTID validation, an in-memory snapshot store with hierarchy queries, ECL (Expression Constraint Language), FHIR terminology building blocks, OWL axiom parsing, and EL-profile subsumption classification with necessary normal form generation. Nine published crates, zero external dependencies.
affiliation: Independent community project, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or certified by SNOMED International. Ships no SNOMED CT content — release files are licensed material obtained under your own affiliate license.
trademark_notice: SNOMED®, SNOMED CT®, and IHTSDO® are registered trademarks of International Health Terminology Standards Development Organisation (IHTSDO). Use of the trademarks does not constitute endorsement of this product by IHTSDO.
link_targets: Repo-relative; resolves inside this git checkout (see spec/llms-json-and-llms-txt/index.md). A website-appropriate version of this file is served from https://snomed-rust.github.io/llms.json.
